whyThisDirectoryExists: The BEA0 candidate lives only in %TEMP%/geogenesis-xbandidx-0b1a2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9.
Temp is volatile and is not under version control, so the candidate and its reproduction
toolchain would be lost. The repository was NOT modified and nothing was git-added.
This directory is therefore a self-contained external snapshot: sources, frozen config,
dependency record, licences, anchors, and runnable build/verify scripts.

howTheSourceClosureWasDetermined.method: Compile-the-head-and-candidate-trees, then follow the compiler. Start from the 17 candidate sources plus the 131 head sources, put the repo src/main/java on -sourcepath, compile, parse every javac 'cannot find symbol' diagnostic, add the uniquely-named matching source, repeat.
howTheSourceClosureWasDetermined.result: 50 main sources, 0 errors, 0 warnings beyond one pre-existing unchecked-cast note in GeoGenesisConfig.java.
howTheSourceClosureWasDetermined.whyNotImportScanning: A plain import scan over the 17 candidate files misses reflective and same-package uses; compiling is the only closure that is proven sufficient. The 50-file set is the smallest set that actually builds.
howTheSourceClosureWasDetermined.verification: repro/build.ps1 hard-asserts the count is exactly 50 and aborts otherwise.
